Hi Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, these slots are free for me (all within working hours):

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30

Does any of them work for you? If none do, tell me a time that suits you and I'll see whether I can make it.
